evidence: The physical thickness of the STO films was measured using an ellipsometer, and the layer density and cation composition were confirmed by X-ray fluorescent spectroscopy (XRF). The rms roughness of the seed layer and main layer as a function of the seed PDA temperature was summarized. The rms roughness decreased to a much lower level (1.3 nm) at temperatures ranging from 625 to 725°C.
